name: NPC Teleporter
description: Teleporter NPCs in capitals (entry 190000) and starting zones (190001).

sql.statement: START TRANSACTION; SET @tp_cap:=(SELECT gossip_menu_id FROM creature_template WHERE entry=190000); SET @tp_zone:=(SELECT gossip_menu_id FROM creature_template WHERE entry=190001); DELETE FROM gossip_menu WHERE MenuID BETWEEN @tp_cap AND @tp_cap+9 AND @tp_cap>0; DELETE FROM gossip_menu WHERE MenuID=@tp_zone AND @tp_zone>0; DELETE FROM gossip_menu_option WHERE MenuID BETWEEN @tp_cap AND @tp_cap+9 AND @tp_cap>0; DELETE FROM gossip_menu_option WHERE MenuID=@tp_zone AND @tp_zone>0; DELETE FROM conditions WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId IN (14,15) AND SourceGroup BETWEEN @tp_cap AND @tp_cap+9 AND @tp_cap>0; DELETE FROM conditions WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId IN (14,15) AND SourceGroup=@tp_zone AND @tp_zone>0; COMMIT;
sql.note: T564: before the files run, clear the menus an earlier Install of THIS module made, found through the two NPCs' gossip_menu_id (not by an id range, which could hold somebody else's menus): upstream's own DELETE only covers the ids it uses now, and an earlier Install may have put them elsewhere (50000.. before T564, 60000..60010 after it). A first Install finds no NPC and deletes nothing. Pinned by tests/test_npc_teleporter_menus.py The statements run in one transaction, so a connection that dies in the middle leaves the world as it was.
upstream sets @ONY_LEVEL := 60 at line 18 and uses it in one row (line 189); the Onyxia step further down writes the answer into that row, so the clone stays unmodified

sql.statement: START TRANSACTION; SET @tp_menu:=(SELECT gossip_menu_id FROM creature_template WHERE entry=190000); SET @tp_free:=(SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gossip_menu WHERE MenuID BETWEEN 60000 AND 60010) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gossip_menu_option WHERE MenuID BETWEEN 60000 AND 60010) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conditions WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId IN (14,15) AND SourceGroup BETWEEN 60000 AND 60010) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creature_template WHERE gossip_menu_id BETWEEN 60000 AND 60010 AND entry NOT IN (190000,190001)) = 0); SET @tp_move:=(@tp_menu=50000 AND @tp_free=1); UPDATE gossip_menu SET MenuID=MenuID+10000 WHERE MenuID BETWEEN 50000 AND 50009 AND @tp_move=1; UPDATE gossip_menu_option SET MenuID=MenuID+10000, ActionMenuID=CASE WHEN ActionMenuID BETWEEN 50000 AND 50009 THEN ActionMenuID+10000 ELSE ActionMenuID END WHERE MenuID BETWEEN 50000 AND 50009 AND @tp_move=1; UPDATE conditions SET SourceGroup=SourceGroup+10000 WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId IN (14,15) AND SourceGroup BETWEEN 50000 AND 50009 AND @tp_move=1; UPDATE smart_scripts SET event_param1=event_param1+10000 WHERE entryorguid=190000 AND source_type=0 AND event_type=62 AND event_param1 BETWEEN 50000 AND 50009 AND @tp_move=1; UPDATE creature_template SET gossip_menu_id=gossip_menu_id+10000 WHERE entry=190000 AND @tp_move=1; COMMIT;

sql.note: T564: teleporter_capital.dist at upstream @06e5242 builds its menus on 50000..50009 after DELETEing them, and those are the ids of Mountaineer Pebblebitty's and Maggran Earthbinder's Searing Gorge gate menus in the base game (19 rows, identical at the pins 7f12e89e and f19a1879). The clone stays unmodified, so right after the file this step moves the teleporter's menus +10000 (50000..50009 to 60000..60009) with every reference to them (gossip_menu, gossip_menu_option MenuID and ActionMenuID, conditions of types 14/15, the SmartAI gossip-select events of creature 190000, its gossip_menu_id). It moves ONLY when the capital NPC still points at 50000 (read once into @tp_menu, since MySQL cannot read the table an UPDATE writes) and 60000..60010 holds nothing: a file that already uses another range (upstream Zoidwaffle/sql-npc-teleporter#6 uses 60000, 60010) is left alone, and an occupied range is refused by `verify` rather than overwritten. Pinned by tests/test_npc_teleporter_menus.py The statements run in one transaction, so a connection that dies in the middle leaves the world as it was.

sql.note: T564: teleporter_starting_zone.dist at upstream @06e5242 uses menu 50009 too, the capital file's battleground menu, which it overwrites; the capital's has been moved out by now, so the zone relocator's single menu is moved to 60010 with its options, conditions, scripts (creature 190001) and gossip_menu_id, under the same two conditions as the capital step The statements run in one transaction, so a connection that dies in the middle leaves the world as it was.
